$schema: Tool configuration for Bitbucket MCP Server
description: Enable or disable MCP tools by setting 'enabled' to true or false

get_repository_tags.description: List recent tags for a repository

get_pull_requests.description: List pull requests for a repository

get_pull_request.description: Get details for a specific pull request

unapprove_pull_request.description: Remove approval from a pull request

request_changes_pull_request.description: Request changes on a pull request (sets status to needs work)

unrequest_changes_pull_request.description: Remove request changes status from a pull request

get_pull_request_comments.description: List comments on a pull request

add_pull_request_comment.description: Add a comment to a pull request

get_pull_request_comment.description: Get a specific comment on a pull request

update_pull_request_comment.description: Update a comment on a pull request

delete_pull_request_comment.description: Delete a comment on a pull request

resolve_pull_request_comment.description: Resolve a comment on a pull request

reopen_pull_request_comment.description: Reopen a resolved comment on a pull request

get_pull_request_diff.description: Get diff for a pull request

get_pull_request_activity.description: Get activity log for a pull request

get_pull_request_commits.description: Get commits on a pull request

get_pull_request_statuses.description: Get build/CI statuses for a pull request

get_pull_request_diffstat.description: Get file modification statistics for a pull request

get_pull_requests_pending_review.description: Get open pull requests pending review by current user

get_pull_request_patch.description: Get the patch for a pull request (git am format, disabled by default — use get_pull_request_diff for AI review)

create_draft_pull_request.description: Create a new pull request as draft

publish_draft_pull_request.description: Publish a draft pull request (convert DRAFT to OPEN)

convert_pull_request_to_draft.description: Convert an open PR to draft (NOT supported by Bitbucket API)

submit_pull_request_batch_review.description: Submit a batch review with multiple comments and optional approve/request changes

get_pull_request_review_summary.description: Get comprehensive review summary for AI-assisted code review

suggest_pull_request_reviewers.description: Suggest reviewers based on default reviewers and PR history

get_pull_request_tasks.description: List tasks on a pull request

get_pull_request_task.description: Get a specific pull request task

create_pull_request_task.description: Create a task on a pull request

get_commit_statuses.description: Get build/CI statuses for a specific commit (Jenkins, CI/CD)

list_commits.description: List commits for a repository (optionally scoped to a revision/path)

get_commit.description: Get details for a single commit

get_commit_comment.description: Get a specific comment on a commit

add_commit_comment.description: Add a comment to a commit (disabled by default — write operation)

get_file_content.description: Get the raw text content of a file at a commit/branch (size/binary guarded)

list_directory.description: List the entries of a directory at a commit/branch

list_pipeline_runs.description: List pipeline runs for a repository

get_pipeline_run.description: Get details for a specific pipeline run

get_pipeline_steps.description: List steps for a pipeline run

get_pipeline_step_logs.description: Get logs for a specific pipeline step (returns the trailing 100 KiB by default; supports start/end byte ranges and service-container logs)

run_pipeline.description: Trigger a new pipeline run on a branch

get_pipeline_config.description: Get repository pipelines configuration (requires admin:repository scope)

list_pipeline_variables.description: List repository pipeline variables (secured values are masked)

create_pipeline_variable.description: Create a repository pipeline variable (disabled by default — write op)

update_pipeline_variable.description: Update a repository pipeline variable (disabled by default — write op)

delete_pipeline_variable.description: Delete a repository pipeline variable (disabled by default — safety)

list_pipeline_schedules.description: List pipeline schedules for a repository

list_pipeline_schedule_executions.description: List executions of a pipeline schedule

create_pipeline_schedule.description: Create a pipeline schedule (disabled by default — write op)

update_pipeline_schedule.description: Update a pipeline schedule (disabled by default — write op)

delete_pipeline_schedule.description: Delete a pipeline schedule (disabled by default — safety)

list_pipeline_caches.description: List pipeline caches for a repository

delete_pipeline_cache.description: Delete a pipeline cache (disabled by default — safety)

get_effective_default_reviewers.description: Get effective default reviewers for a repository

list_issues.description: List issues in a repository issue tracker (filter by state/kind/priority/assignee/BBQL)

get_issue.description: Get details for a specific issue

update_issue.description: Update an issue (title, content, state, kind, priority, assignee)

delete_issue.description: Delete an issue (disabled by default for safety)

get_issue_comment.description: Get a specific comment on an issue

add_issue_comment.description: Add a comment to an issue

update_issue_comment.description: Update a comment on an issue

delete_issue_comment.description: Delete a comment on an issue (disabled by default for safety)

list_deployments.description: List deployments (history); filter by environment client-side

get_deployment.description: Get a single deployment (state, environment, commit)

list_deployment_variables.description: List deployment environment variables (secured values masked)

create_environment.description: Create a deployment environment (disabled by default — write op, deployment:write)

delete_environment.description: Delete a deployment environment (disabled by default — safety)

create_deployment_variable.description: Create a deployment environment variable (disabled by default — write op)

update_deployment_variable.description: Update a deployment environment variable (disabled by default — write op)

delete_deployment_variable.description: Delete a deployment environment variable (disabled by default — safety)

create_branch_restriction.description: Create a branch restriction (disabled by default — write op, repository:admin)

update_branch_restriction.description: Update a branch restriction (disabled by default — write op)

delete_branch_restriction.description: Delete a branch restriction (disabled by default — safety)

list_repository_permissions.description: List user permissions for a specific repository

review_pull_request.description: Slash command: complete AI review of a pull request

debug_pipeline_failure.description: Slash command: diagnose a failed pipeline run from its logs

summarize_repository.description: Slash command: summarize a repository (purpose, activity, health)

onboard_reviewer.description: Slash command: help a new reviewer get up to speed on a PR
